body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> AutoXray introduced the new Drive Assure Engine Light Urgency Indicator at the 2008, International Consumer Electronics Show (CES). Drive Assure provides motorists with an immediate diagnosis when their vehicle’s check engine light illuminates. According to company, it is the first tool in the market to indicate how urgent the check engine light problem is to a vehicle’s drivability.

Users can quickly and easily diagnose the urgency of the problem with the Drive Assure Engine Light Urgency Indicator displayed 4 color-coded light of red, orange, yellow and green ranging from urgent to okay status.
Jennifer Grabowski, Product Manager, explained that the Drive Assure Energy Light Urgency Indicator takes the next step of immediately advising how soon a vehicle should be repaired.
